name: text-field
title: Text field
summary: Lets people type a value, on a hairline, with its label above and help or an error below.
use: For short values (one line) or longer text (multiline).

options.name: placeholder
options.description: An example value in faint, never the label.

options.name: help
options.description: One muted sentence below the field.

options.name: error
options.description: Replaces the help with an error dot and the message.

options.name: action
options.description: One trailing action, such as submit, clear or reveal.

rules: No boxes: the field is a hairline that darkens on hover and focus.
An error says what to do, not only what is wrong.
accessibility: The label is tied to the field.
Errors set aria-invalid and are announced.
